## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tried it on a phone or tablet (or the browser's phone view)
- [ ] Traced a few letters from start to finish, capital and small
- [ ] Looked at it in light and night mode

## Kids first

- [ ] No new personal data about children (no names beyond the optional first name, no photos, locations or IP addresses)
- [ ] No ads, trackers or third-party scripts
- [ ] Short words and big buttons
